name: Plain of Six Glaciers
why: Along Lake Louise and up the moraines toward the Victoria Glacier to a teahouse built by Swiss guides in 1927, with ice falls all around.
book: Parks Canada Lake Louise shuttle reservation (reservation.pc.gc.ca), or arrive before 7:00 for the paid Lake Louise parking. The teahouse takes cash only and is open from June to early October.
water: Tea and water at the teahouse in season.
dangers: Avalanche terrain from November to mid-May.
Rockfall and ice avalanches past the teahouse toward Abbot Pass: stay on the trail.
